TERMINATION AGREEMENT
This termination agreement ("Termination Agreement") is made on this 8 December, 2022
at Lahore by and between:
Mr. Jawed IqbaI Sb Qutab Ud Din Paracha, holding CNIC No. 42201-7634394-9.
resident of House No. 253, Block Z, Phase Ill, DHA, Lahore (hereinafter referred to
as the "Lessor" which expression shall, where the context so permits or requires,
means and includes its successors-in-interest, legal heirs and assigns)
AND
Zameen Media (Private) Limited, a company incorporated under the laws of
Pakistan and having its registered office at 94-B/I, M.M. Alam Road, Gulberg Ill,
Lahore through its authorized representative Ms. Mariam Saleem Akbar (hereinafter
referred to as the "Lessee" which term shall, wherever the context so requires or
permits, means and includes its successors-in-interest and assigns).
Each a "Party" and, collectively, "Parties".
WHEREAS:
A.

The Lessor had rented out and Lessee had taken on rent entire basement and ground floors,
having an area measuring fifty-four hundred (5400) sq. ft., of the commercial building
located at Main Susan Road, Faisalabad (the Demised Premises") vide Lease
Agreement dated 5th January, 2021 (the "Lease Agreement").

B.

The Lessor and the Lessee are now desirous of terminating the Lease Agreement. which
shall be terminated in accordance with the terms and conditions set forth herein.

NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows:
1. The Parties mutually agree to terminate the Lease Agreement with effect from 315t
December, 2022 ("Termination Date").
2. The Parties acknowledge that the Lessee has already paid rent for the Demised Premises
for the period co •-n€e on 01St July 2022 and ending on 31St December, 2022, amounting

Page 1 of 2
THIS DOCUMENT IS CONFIDENTIAL AND PROPRIETARY

to Rs. 2,850,000 (Rupees Two Million Eight Hundred Fifty Thousand) which was paid vide
cheque No. 40287379, dated 2O July 2022, drawn on Bank Alfalah in favor of the Lessor.
3. The Lessor, upon inspection of the Demised Premises, hereby confirms that the Demised
Premises is in good order and condition and free of any damage. Upon Termination Date,
the Lessor shall be liable to refund the complete security deposit amounting to Rs.
2,850,000 (Rupees Two Million and Eight Hundred Fifty Thousand) ('Security Deposit")
to the Lessee. The parties agree that the Security Deposit payable by the Lessor to the
Lessee shall be treated as security deposit in the lease agreement that is to be executed
between the Lessee and Ms. Saima Javed w/o Mr. Jawed lqbal.
4. The Parties acknowledge that the Lease Agreement shall stand terminated as on the
Termination Date, and neither Party shall have any further rights or obligations whatsoever
under the Lease Agreement.
5. The Parties, their employees, agents, sub-contractors, successors and assigns, hereby
discharge and release each other from any and all claims, demands, obligations, liabilities,
or causes of action, whether known or unknown, arising out of or relating to the Lease
Agreement.
6. This Termination Agreement is the entire agreement between the Parties and supersedes
any and all prior agreements and understandings between the Parties, whether written or
oral.
7. This Agreement may be entered into in any number of counterparts, all of which taken
together shall constitute one and the same.
IN WITNESSS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have executed this Termination Agreement, on the
day, month and year mentioned above.

SIGNED

For and on behalf of Lessor

For and on behalf of Lessee

Jawed lqbal

Mariam Saleem Akbar
